convention.matrix: 4x4 column-major (three, glTF): elements 12, 13, 14 are the translation; Godot: basis = columns 0..2, origin = column 3
convention.instances: world.glb: EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing TRANSLATION (the matrix translation, float32 bit for bit), ROTATION (unit quaternion x, y, z, w), SCALE, and _COLOR, _AN, _AC2, _AP0, _AP1 (the per-instance extras); the JSON form: matrices, 16 floats an instance
convention.winding: front faces counter-clockwise seen from outside (three, glTF); Godot's are clockwise: a reader of the JSON form reverses each triangle (a glTF importer already does)
convention.uv: as three holds them; a texture samples at uv * repeat + offset, and flipY true puts the image's top row at v = 1 (Godot samples 1 - v), false at v = 0

colours.materials: linear (three's working values written as hex: do not convert)

convention.typed: {type, n, b64}: the array's bytes, little-endian, base64; Float32Array, Uint16Array, Uint32Array
convention.ids: core/tags: a record id is <prefix>_<5 digits> (or the build's own); an instance of an item set is <set id>#<index>; a uid is KTAGS.uid(class, key, at): KRAND.hash(0, fnv1a(class), fnv1a(key), floor(x*10+.5), floor(y*10+.5), floor(z*10+.5)) as 8 hex digits
convention.box: [x0, z0, x1, z1]: an instance belongs to a tile when x0 <= x < x1 and z0 <= z < z1 (its origin); a bucket piece by its foot (the xz of its lowest vertex)

records.name: The smiths and the lens workshop
The Lower Gate and the hall of pillars (the paired drums)
The White Palace (the School, the cells, the refectory, Testimony, the Restoration Halls, the library)
The Debate Court (open from the School to the sky, curved arcaded galleries)
The Great Assembly Hall (a drum under a tile cone and lantern, the skylight columns inside)
The Red Palace (the Founders' tombs, the Great Archive, the Chronicle Hall, the Council, the Abbot)
The Red Palace's wings (the conservators, the map room, the chroniclers)
The gilded roof over the Chronicle Hall
The gilded roof over the West Founders' hall
The gilded roof over the East Founders' hall
The Hall of Hours (the water, sand and Ancient clocks; its dial faces the valley)
The Eastern Watch (the Order's bell; instruments that read the Lizardmen's strangeness)
The masters' meditation cells (the rear terrace)
The rear shrine and the spring house
The Closed Ward (one door, one warden; a garden open to the sky)
The outer wall (7 m of whitewashed stone on a granite plinth)
The wardens' and operatives' drill ground
The Great Stair (three ramps up the White Palace's base)
The stair house on the Red Palace's roof (the stair up from the top storey to the roof walk)
The Garden of Held Water: the held fountain and the held cherry
A chorten (a stupa of the Order: white, the gilt rings and the sun and moon)
A chorten (a stupa of the Order: white, the gilt rings and the sun and moon)
A row of prayer wheels under its gallery
A row of prayer wheels under its gallery
A row of prayer wheels under its gallery
The Deep Stair (one stair down, no other way)
The Warden's gate and the keepers' vestibule (the register)
The open vault (the relics on their shelves, each under its card)
The closed vault (the cells behind the seals)
The three quiet cells (the time relics: lead-lined, a bell at each door, no clocks in the passage)
The Unmaking Room (for what must not exist)
The Sealed Library (the quarantine of knowledge: one reading room, one desk)
The Long Stair down to the Procrastinator (the eldest keepers only)
The passage to the Unmaking Room
The foot of the Long Stair (the last passage before the hall)
The Cistern of the rock (the rock's water, gathered from its seams)
LS-011 a clock that runs at its owner's pace
LS-014 the abacus that counts what is missing
LS-019 a glass of air from before the Cataclysm
LS-023 the Ancient lamp that lights only the past
LS-031 a map that is always of tomorrow
LS-037 a cup that cannot be emptied of the same tea
LS-042 a mask of the first Abbot (it speaks at the change of the year)
LS-055 a sealed letter addressed to the reader
LS-061 a pair of sandals worn by a monk who ran too fast
The Procrastinator (a prayer wheel the size of a tower; its glyphs burn; it is never stopped)
The hall of the Procrastinator (the deepest room of Longsong)
LS-002 · The Bell That Rings Backward
LS-004 · The Moth of Many Eyes
The yak pastures (the apron's upper slope toward the valley wall)
The ward's orchard and the beehives
The bee wall (a willow skep in each niche: the lamps' wax is the bees')

harvest.notes: Shelf fungi banded in rings of teal, gold and blue on the old trunks; a tea of them is the monks' long-life tonic.
The moss garden: over the floor, the stones, the fallen wood and the roots, bright in the shade.
The moss garden: over the floor, the stones, the fallen wood and the roots, bright in the shade.
Cherries in early summer; the bark is a cough tea. The petals are gathered for the spring cakes.
Cherries in early summer; the bark is a cough tea. The petals are gathered for the spring cakes.
The moss of the balls dresses wounds; the dead balls stuff cushions.

harvest.wood: chests and boxes (the wood keeps the moth out)
harvest.notes: Camphor: the wood is steamed for its crystals, the monks' liniment and a reagent that clears the head.
Xanadu's mist tea, wild on the terraces; the valley's drink.
A powder-blue poppy on the slopes; its seed is a sleeping draught and a reagent of the stillness rites, and its leaves are the vat the Order's blue is dyed in.
Clipped-looking domes of small leaves on the meadows, nobody's clipping.
The valley's stones stand in threes, fives and sevens, as if set; the monks say the valley set them.

cropped.rule: the records an item or bucket of the tile names, the records whose at lies in the box (not item sets), and their parents

grid.note: h(x, z) sampled at x0 + i*step, z0 + j*step (row j, column i): the ground the page reads, on the export's own grid

probes.rule: x0 + (i + 0.37)/N * width, z0 + (j + 0.71)/N * depth, N = 16: off the lattice, so a port's interpolation is tested too

convention.dir: the direction a light travels, world, unit

convention.ry: radians about +y; local +z turns to (sin ry, cos ry)
convention.hours: 0..24; a light [on,off] is lit from on in the evening to off next morning (off may be past 24; on<0 follows the night; on=0 always)
convention.instance: [x,y,z, sx,sy,sz, ry | [rx,ry,rz] YXZ euler, color|null]; geometry is unit-sized, posts and cones stand on y=0

uniforms.atm_ash: 0..1 the opt-in ash weather (ashfall .35, the storm 1)
uniforms.atm_snow: 0..1 the opt-in snow weather (snowfall .4, the blizzard 1)
uniforms.atm_px: pixels per metre at 1 m (sprite sizing)
uniforms.atm_wave_t: module clock wrapped at presets.waves.period, s (atmos_waves)

fx.note: auto: rain ramps up over the first pair of hours and down over the second; fog = scale * ramps. W.rain/fog/wet/flash/wind are the state a host reads

water.clock: the shaders read the module clock wrapped at period (atmWaveT; Godot: the global atm_wave_t); the twins take seconds and wrap them
water.note: open: rest point p0 moves to p0 + m * sum H D cos(th), y = level + m * (sum A sin(th) + field * waveHeight(p)), th = 2 pi (fract(p0.x tx) + fract(p0.z tz) - fract(t tc)) + phase; m = smoothstep(0, damp, depth) from the bed (1 without one); heightAt inverts it by Newton (core/water/README.md)

glb.note: items are nodes item_<k> and buckets bucket_<k>, k their index in this file's lists
